channel.title: FringeNode
channel.description: AI engineering for living systems. Field guides and notes from the edges.

item.title: Checkpoint 02 · Land Restoration Tech Tree
item.description: Checkpoint 02: the map of parts for a FringeNode site. What already exists, what still has to be built, and what must exist first, for a small computer that stays on a piece of land and helps that land recover.

item.title: Field Guide 05 · Evals for Beginners
item.description: A practice field guide to evaluations (evals): write a small golden set for the Friday supplier job, grade with exact checks first, tell a capability test from a regression test, and reuse the set after every change. This guide does not use a hosted evaluation product.

item.title: Checkpoint 01 · The Closed Loop
item.description: The whole FringeNode idea as one cycle: a small solar computer on the land learns from a healthy reference area, watches a damaged plot, proposes one small fix, and measures whether it helped. What exists today, and what is still a plan.

item.title: Field Guide 04 · Your First Agent, Safely
item.description: A practice field guide: design a first agent that can read supplier notes and draft a reply, but cannot send, delete, or spend, with least privilege, a human approval step, and a worked prompt-injection example.

item.title: Field Guide 03 · Context Engineering in Practice
item.description: A practice field guide to context engineering: pack a messy-versus-focused window for a supplier delivery job, handle work that outgrows one window, treat safety as a packing choice, and leave with a reusable checklist.

item.title: Field Guide 02 · The AI Jargon Field Guide
item.description: The 19 AI terms to learn first for AI engineering and agent orchestration, in stack order, ending on context engineering. Plus a skimmable glossary of 78 more.

item.title: Field Guide 01 · Understanding AI
item.description: A beginner field guide to open-weight models, running them locally, agents, and privacy.
